summary: Frontend-only regression + new chapters testing for AURELIS VELA iteration 2. Loader completes (~2s to fade), HUD present (canvas rendered), body scrollHeight=17532px (~16.2 viewports). All 3 new chapters (chapter-material, chapter-configurator, chapter-finale) exist in DOM. Menu navigation to material/configurator/contact/experience all smooth-scroll to correct offsets (7776 / 14232 / 16392 / 0). Material images all load with naturalWidth=1264 (4/4). Configurator console renders with all 9 swatches/buttons; each click succeeded without errors and screenshot confirms active state is shown visually (orange border on selected wheel/interior; filled ring on selected body swatch). Finale marquee + 'THE FUTURE DOESN'T WAIT.' heading + contact-cta visible; CTA clicks without error. Sound toggle cycles Sound Off <-> Sound On correctly. Zero uncaught JS/React errors and zero console errors captured during the entire flow.

ui_bugs.issue: [data-testid=scroll-progress] is present in DOM but is_visible() returned False on desktop viewport (1920x1080) at scrollY=0. Likely very low opacity or off-screen initially. Minor/cosmetic.

issues: Body/Wheel/Interior selection buttons do not expose aria-pressed or data-active attributes (visual active state works via className/child dot). Consider adding aria-pressed for accessibility & testability.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate why [data-testid=scroll-progress] is not visible on desktop at top of page.
(Optional/A11y) Add aria-pressed to config-body-*, config-wheel-*, config-interior-* buttons to make active state programmatically observable.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical issues found. All new chapters (Material/Configurator/Finale) integrate cleanly with the pinned WebGL hero; menu -> section scroll offsets are correct and produce non-zero scrollY without page reload/flash.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 review items pass; 1 minor a11y observation)

context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a heavy single-route WebGL experience. Note: page.goto with wait_until='load' will time out (>10s) due to WebGL/asset loading — use default networkidle-avoidance and instead poll for [data-testid=loader-screen] computed opacity==0 (element remains in DOM after fade-out, so wait_for state='detached' will NOT work). Wait ~2-3s after loader opacity hits 0 before interacting. All menu items work: menu-item-{experience,material,configurator,contact} scroll to 0 / 7776 / 14232 / 16392 respectively at 1920x1080. Configurator active-state indicated via className (orange border on wheels/interior; filled ring on body swatches) — no aria-pressed. Zero JS errors during full flow.
